options.description: A red line in the band naming which judge and why in plain words: no key, network down or timed out, the provider's error, or a quota. Kept separate from 'the judge answered but its question was set aside', which says which question and why. It stays until the judge answers again.
options.label: Red band + exact why (Recommended)

options.description: As today, a single line in the chat the first time, but with the precise cause and the split between 'unreachable' and 'answered but set aside'. No band item.
options.label: One chat line per session

options.description: The red band item, plus the line in the chat the first time it happens.
options.label: Both
